app.name: Harbor
app.subtitle: Family Care & Safe Shared-Pot Cooking Manager

landing.heroTitle: One safe pot for the whole family, medicines timed to real meals
landing.heroDesc: When a household manages diabetes, hypertension, kidney disease, or food allergies together, cooking 3–4 separate dishes daily is unrealistic. Harbor uses deterministic Python rules to verify what everyone can eat and when to set aside one adapted portion.
landing.step1Desc: Transcribes Bangla speech, parses informal stock events, and reads prescription drafts—AI never decides food safety.
landing.step2Desc: Pure Python engine checks allergens, confirmed drug-food rules, and diet presets with zero network calls or hallucinations.
landing.step3Desc: Every explanation is checked against tool logs before display, while meal-timed reminders keep elderly patients safe.

welcome.title: Create or Log Into Household
welcome.subtitle: Use your household access code and caregiver PIN, or set up a new household.
welcome.consentBody: Third-party AI APIs are used to transcribe Bangla voice logs and draft prescription tables. Prescription photos are NEVER stored on our servers—only caregiver-confirmed fields are saved.
welcome.consentCheckbox: I understand and consent (images will not be stored).
welcome.consentRequired: Please tick the privacy consent box before continuing.
welcome.createdSuccess: Household created! Save your access code.
welcome.demoTipBody: Demo household uses code DEMO26 and PIN 1234 (ready to load once the backend API routes are wired).

settings.title: Settings & Preferences
settings.subtitle: Manage language conversion (EN ↔ BN), theme, meal times, notifications, and demo household.
settings.languageCardDesc: Switch the entire app interface, safety badges, menu explanations, and numerals between Bangla and English in one tap.
settings.themeCardDesc: Warm neumorphic, skeuomorphic, and glass UI in both Light and Dark modes (strictly no blue, purple, or green).
settings.mealTimesDesc: Medicine reminder due windows are computed directly from these mealtimes.
settings.pushHint: Lock-screen notifications never mention diseases or medicines—generic text only ("Time for medicine").
settings.demoDesc: Loads Father (CKD, low potassium), Mother (diabetes/hypertension + Enalapril), Arif (prawn allergy), and Sumaiya (caregiver).

styleguide.title: Design System & Styleguide
styleguide.subtitle: Neumorphism, Skeuomorphism, and Glass primitives — verified with live WCAG contrast checks in Light & Dark modes.
styleguide.paletteRule: Theme constraint: zero blue, purple, or green hues anywhere in the system.
styleguide.surfacesTitle: Three Material Layers: Neumorphic, Glass & Skeuomorphic
styleguide.neuRaisedDesc: Used for primary dish cards, member tiles, and overview summaries.
styleguide.neuInsetDesc: Used for input fields, recessed compartments, and active states.
styleguide.glassDesc: Used for top app bar, bottom navigation, modal sheets, and blocked-panel headers.
styleguide.patientHeroTitle: Skeuomorphic Patient Hero Dome (Disease-Free, High Contrast)
styleguide.controlsTitle: Buttons, Inputs, Toggles, Tabs & Glass Sheet
styleguide.sheetBody: Translucent blurred overlay sheet used for guest review and quick actions.
